name: counter_harmful
description: The harmful-command test: never with the restorative flag; else any damage class, any non-zero permanent status chance, Sleep, Silence, Darkness or Slow with a non-zero chance and duration, or an Eject, Curse or Doom bit.

harness.note: the real machine code of the function in an x86-32 emulator; the three status-flag tables read from the exe memory; queue inserts hooked

notes: in.chances is [status number, byte] pairs, in.durations [temporal slot, byte] pairs; the vectors ran with the game's three status-flag tables read from memory.
